title: Relief opening.
officialText:
The design of the installation shall include adequate provision to permit direct-fired industrial air heaters to
operate at rated capacity by taking into account the structure’s designed infiltration rate, providing properly designed relief openings
or an interlocked power exhaust system, or a combination of these methods. The structure’s designed infiltration rate and the size of
relief openings shall be determined by a registered design professional. Relief openings shall be permitted to be louvers or
counterbalanced gravity dampers. Motorized dampers or closable louvers shall be permitted to be used, provided they are verified to
be in their full open position prior to main burner operation.
